newsitem.title: USA: Servico says got $136 mln in public offering.
newsitem.headline: Servico says got $136 mln in public offering.

text.p: Servico Inc said Wednesday net proceeds were about $136 million from the sale of 10 million shares in its public offering of common stock.
The company said the price of the offering was of $14.50 per share.
The proceeds of the offering will be used to repay about $131 million of indebtedness, reducing the debt to market long-term capitalization from about 66 percent to 35 percent.
The offering was lead managed by Lehman Brothers with Alex. Brown & Sons Inc, Montgomery Securities and Raymond James & Associates Inc as co-managers.
The underwriters have an over-allotment option to acquire up to an additional 1.5 million shares.

Servico also announced it has obtained a commitment letter from Lehman Brothers Holdings Inc with respect to a $100 million, three year senior secured credit facility for working capital purposes, including the acquisition of additional hotels.
Funding of the credit facility will be subject to execution of a definitive credit agreement.
Servico owns or manages sixty hotels.
